_comment: Written by ./install.sh (interactive). Or copy to config.json and edit. Gitignored — per-user.
_harnesses: Targets: link the unified store into these harnesses.
_adopt_from: Sources: pull existing skills/memory/instructions/commands FROM these into the store (subset of targets).
_accounts: ILLUSTRATIVE SHAPE ONLY — `make install` auto-detects YOUR real accounts (Claude ~/.claude* dirs, Codex ~/.codex* dirs) and lets you add more during setup; it does not use the entries below. Provider-agnostic, any number of any type. provider = anthropic-sub (config_dir = a CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR + optional keychain) | chatgpt-sub (codex_home = its own CODEX_HOME so multiple Codex logins don't collide + port for its LiteLLM instance) | openai-key (env_key + base_url). Two of the same provider = two config dirs, exactly like running two Claude Code or two Codex profiles.
_claude_in_opencode: LEGACY, keep false. Old shim (opencode-claude-auth) from the Jan-Apr 2026 blocked era. Anthropic reinstated third-party subscription use May/Jun 2026 — use opencode's native `opencode auth login` -> Anthropic instead. Code kept; installer no longer offers this.
